newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude Medical Q4 net loss after charges.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude Medical Q4 net loss after charges.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Q4 1996 includes purchased R & D charges of $35.4 million pertaining to its Telectronics and Biocor acquisitions, and special charges of $47.8 million, including $25 million payment to Intermedics Inc to resolve patent and legal disputes, $11.1 million in charges to reposition its tissue heart valve business, $7.7 million in distributor termination charges, $2.2 million in Pacesetter integration charges and $1.8 million in miscellaneous charges. On an adjusted basis, the company reported a Q4 profit of $0.47 a share versus a profit of $0.44 a share.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Results for 12 months ended December 31, 1996 include $40.4 million in charges related to purchased R & D and $47.8 million in special charges.
